name: centertest-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for CenterTest test automation development

plugins.name: centertest-healthcheck
plugins.description: Suite health for QA architects: trust verdict, what the regression covers (coverages, options, jurisdictions, flows, suites), branch review, trend, portfolio, weekly, release plans, client coverage statement — HTML, Excel, PR comment, JSON

plugins.name: cssid-finder
plugins.description: Find Java getter chains for Guidewire UI CSS IDs, or by the words on screen

plugins.name: ddt-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyze CenterTest Data-Driven Testing structure — 28-sheet Excel report (17 without Data Studio)

plugins.name: ddt-tools
plugins.description: Validate DC references, diff xlsx, report unused codes — interactive or as JSON

plugins.name: recording-to-test
plugins.description: Scenario wizard: create a CenterTest test from a Recorder recording, a request, a story, a Jira issue or an existing test, reusing the project's own tests, data and facades

plugins.name: suite-builder
plugins.description: Build and edit CenterTest suites: pick classes, methods and DDT rows, add/remove/delete/rename suites, see what each suite runs
